Noto Sans SC test subset, licensed under SIL OFL 1.1 (see OFL.txt).
Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/2fe1e8c6b137fb13041a7cfca6fdcd8a910ea4dc/ofl/notosanssc
File: NotoSansSC[wght].ttf
Subset made with FontTools:
  fonttools subset 'NotoSansSC[wght].ttf' --text='漢字' --output-file=NotoSansSC-subset.ttf
Only these two characters are retained to exercise offline CJK PDF extraction.
This fixture supplies glyph coverage; product font selection is unchanged.
